# Danny On The Air (danny.vn)

> Personal site of Danny, a security engineer building open-source security-as-code
> CLIs and regulatory AI tools in Go, C, and Python.

## Security as Code

- [secopsctl](https://github.com/dannyota/secops): operate Google SecOps (Chronicle SIEM + Siemplify SOAR) as code
- [s1ctl](https://github.com/dannyota/s1ctl): operate SentinelOne Singularity as code
- [splunkctl](https://github.com/dannyota/splunkctl): operate Splunk Enterprise SIEM as code

## Regulatory AI

One codebase (github.com/dannyota/banhmi), one corpus per country. Free MCP endpoints, no signup:

- [banhmi](https://banhmi.danny.vn): Vietnamese banking & fintech regulation (MCP: banhmi.danny.vn/mcp)
- [laksa](https://laksa.danny.vn): Malaysian banking & fintech regulation (MCP: laksa.danny.vn/mcp)
- [rendang](https://rendang.danny.vn): Indonesian banking & fintech regulation (MCP: rendang.danny.vn/mcp)
- [kaya](https://kaya.danny.vn): Singaporean banking & fintech regulation (MCP: kaya.danny.vn/mcp)

## Go SDKs (vanity imports on danny.vn)

- danny.vn/s1: SentinelOne Singularity
- danny.vn/secops: Google SecOps
- danny.vn/fortigate: FortiGate firewall REST API
- danny.vn/fortimgr: FortiManager FlatUI API
- danny.vn/nessus: Tenable Nessus scanner (read-only)
- danny.vn/vngcloud: VNG Cloud IAM
- danny.vn/kaggle: Kaggle API

## Other

- [offthebook](https://github.com/dannyota/offthebook): memory-only Windows PE execution research
- [onnxruntime/go](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29615): Go bindings for ONNX Runtime C API via CGO (open PR on microsoft/onnxruntime)
- [flowcvcli](https://github.com/dannyota/flowcvcli): FlowCV résumé CLI
- All repositories: https://github.com/dannyota
